name: Maria–Eleni Konsta
intro: I connect performance, brand and commerce to build meaningful digital experiences. From international retail to precision medicine, I bring strategic thinking, hands-on execution and a people-first approach to marketing.
summary: Digital Marketing Leader with an MSc in International Marketing and experience across healthcare, retail and e-commerce. Promoted to Head of Digital at GENEKOR in under a year, leading a team across European B2B and B2C markets. Combines performance marketing, clear communication and hands-on delivery.
about: I lead digital marketing across European B2B and B2C markets, combining performance marketing, e-commerce and brand communication. At GENEKOR, I progressed to Head of Digital in under a year, leading a team in healthcare.

With an MSc in International Marketing and experience at JUMBO and Anubis, I work across Google Ads, Meta advertising, SEO, social media, content strategy and email marketing. I bring customer insight, analytical thinking and cross-functional collaboration to campaign strategy, conversion optimisation and performance reporting.
